current_disclosures.section: Products, Market, and Sales > Product Technologies
current_disclosures.summary: DRAM products are volatile, low-latency memory devices used in various markets including data centers, PCs, and automotive. In 2025, the company began shipping the industry's first 1γ production node incorporating EUV lithography for improved efficiency, while the majority of DRAM bit production remained on the 1ß node. This portfolio includes specialized types such as High-Bandwidth Memory (HBM) for AI and high-performance computing, Double Data Rate (DDR) including DDR5, Low-Power DRAM (LPDDR) for mobile devices, and Graphics DRAM (GDDR) for graphics-intensive applications.

comparisons.peer_topic: Data center and cloud computing solutions
comparisons.peer_summary: The company offers a deep portfolio of data center solutions including AI accelerators, CPUs, GPUs, DPUs, SmartNICs, and FPGAs to meet performance requirements for data centers, supercomputers, and cloud environments.
comparisons.comparison: Both MU and AMD position their GPU offerings as critical infrastructure for AI workloads in data centers. MU highlights that its graphics products (GDDR6/6X) are the 'driving force behind applications such as AI' in GPU-based data center solutions, while AMD offers a portfolio including 'graphic processing units (GPUs)' and 'AI accelerators' specifically to meet the performance requirements of 'AI and Machine Learning (ML) data center environments'.

sentences.text: Our GDDR6 and GDDR6X DRAM graphics products are incorporated into gaming consoles, PC graphics cards, and graphics processing unit-based data center solutions, which are the driving force behind applications such as AI, virtual and augmented reality, 4K and 8K gaming, and professional design.

We offer a deep portfolio of data center computing solutions including AI accelerators, microprocessors (CPUs), graphic processing units (GPUs), data processing units (DPUs), Smart Network Interface Cards (SmartNICs), and field programmable gate arrays (FPGAs), to meet the vast computing performance requirements of today's data centers, supercomputers, AI and Machine Learning (ML) data center environments and cloud environments.

comparisons.peer_summary: The AMD Radeon PRO family provides professional graphics products optimized for demanding use cases such as 3D rendering, CAD, and media/entertainment pipelines on high-resolution displays.
comparisons.comparison: While MU focuses on the graphics memory component (GDDR7) powering the graphics market, AMD provides a direct comparison through its professional GPU hardware. AMD's Radeon PRO family is explicitly optimized for 'high resolution displays' and demanding graphics use cases, mirroring MU's description of its GDDR products supporting '4K and 8K gaming' and professional design applications.

sentences.text: The addition of GDDR7 completes our industry-leading product portfolio for AI inference applications on CPUs, neural processing units, and graphics processing units.

Our GDDR6 and GDDR6X DRAM graphics products are incorporated into gaming consoles, PC graphics cards, and graphics processing unit-based data center solutions, which are the driving force behind applications such as AI, virtual and augmented reality, 4K and 8K gaming, and professional design.

Our AMD Radeon PRO family of professional graphics products are designed for integration in desktop workstations, optimized through hardware and software for demanding use cases such as 3D rendering, design and manufacturing for Computer-Aided Design (CAD), and media and entertainment for broadcast and animation pipelines on high resolution displays.

comparisons.peer_summary: The company provides advanced technology and IP platforms for customers to design ASICs targeting AI, high-performance computing, and networking applications.
comparisons.comparison: MU and AVGO both address the hardware foundations for AI inference but at different layers of the stack. MU states that its GDDR7 memory 'completes our industry-leading product portfolio for AI inference applications on... graphics processing units.' AVGO complements this by providing 'Custom Silicon Solutions' where customers design ASICs that 'integrate embedded logic, memory, serializer/deserializer ("SerDes") technology, IP cores and processor cores' for AI applications. Both identify memory/connectivity and custom silicon as enablers for AI inference.

sentences.text: The addition of GDDR7 completes our industry-leading product portfolio for AI inference applications on CPUs, neural processing units, and graphics processing units.

• Custom Silicon Solutions: We provide advanced technology and intellectual property ("IP") platforms for customers to design and develop application specific integrated circuits ("ASICs") targeting AI and high-performance computing, networking and storage applications. Our custom silicon provides the platform to integrate embedded logic, memory, serializer/deserializer ("SerDes") technology, IP cores and processor cores. ASICs are custom products built to individual customers specifications.

comparisons.peer_summary: In 2024, Intel launched the Intel Gaudi 3 AI accelerators, offering significant price-performance advantages for AI inference applications.
comparisons.comparison: MU and INTC both explicitly reference the convergence of memory/hardware with AI inference capabilities in 2024. MU announced GDDR7 to complete its portfolio for 'AI inference applications on CPUs, neural processing units, and graphics processing units.' INTC launched the Gaudi 3 AI accelerators offering 'price-performance advantages for AI inference applications.' Both disclosures highlight a strategic focus on optimizing hardware specifically for the inference workload.

comparisons.peer_topic: NVIDIA RTX Technology and AI Integration
comparisons.peer_summary: NVIDIA RTX enhances gaming through real-time ray tracing for cinematic-quality rendering and DLSS, an AI technology that boosts frame rates, positioning RTX as the AI PC leader with over 100 million AI-capable PCs and 500+ enabled applications.
comparisons.comparison: MU and NVDA both describe their graphics technologies as integral to the rise of AI-powered personal computing. MU notes its GDDR products drive 'AI' applications in data centers and graphics markets, while NVDA positions its RTX platform as the 'AI PC leader' with over 100 million 'AI capable PCs' and RTX GPUs that 'accelerate a new generation of AI applications.' Both link graphics advancement directly to the AI ecosystem.

sentences.text: Our GDDR6 and GDDR6X DRAM graphics products are incorporated into gaming consoles, PC graphics cards, and graphics processing unit-based data center solutions, which are the driving force behind applications such as AI, virtual and augmented reality, 4K and 8K gaming, and professional design.
The addition of GDDR7 completes our industry-leading product portfolio for AI inference applications on CPUs, neural processing units, and graphics processing units.

comparisons.peer_topic: Processor architecture and AI Engine capabilities
comparisons.peer_summary: Qualcomm utilizes System-on-Chip architecture with heterogeneous computing, including Oryon and Kryo CPUs and Adreno GPUs, to enable high-performance, low-power computing. The Qualcomm AI Engine features dedicated hardware and the Hexagon NPU for high-performance on-device AI inference, supported by the AI Stack and AI Hub to simplify developer integration.
comparisons.comparison: MU and QCOM both highlight the role of specific hardware engines in enabling AI inference on client and edge devices. MU mentions its portfolio covers 'AI inference applications on... neural processing units.' QCOM details its 'Qualcomm® Hexagon™ NPU' as a key processor 'designed for sustained, high-performance AI inference' within its Snapdragon platforms. Both identify the NPU/memory subsystem as critical for on-device AI capabilities.

sentences.text: The addition of GDDR7 completes our industry-leading product portfolio for AI inference applications on CPUs, neural processing units, and graphics processing units.

Our Qualcomm® Hexagon™ NPU is a key processor in our AI Engine and is designed for sustained, high-performance AI inference, enabling leading on-device AI capabilities with very low power consumption.
